description: Parse a .proto file's message definitions and flag reused field numbers, gaps in the field-number sequence that aren't covered by a "reserved" or "extensions" statement, and field numbers outside the valid range (1 to 536,870,911, excluding 19000-19999, reserved for the protobuf implementation). Each message (including nested ones) gets its own independent field-number space, and oneof fields count toward their enclosing message.
name: check_proto_field_numbers
